stem: The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on:
solution: The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution on 26 November 1949, now observed as Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas).

stem: The Constitution of India came into force on:
solution: The Constitution came into effect on 26 January 1950, celebrated as Republic Day.

stem: The Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution was:
solution: Dr B. R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee and is regarded as the chief architect of the Constitution.

stem: The introductory statement of the Constitution, setting out its ideals and objectives, is called the:
solution: The Preamble is the opening statement that lays out the guiding values and objectives of the Constitution.

stem: According to the Preamble, India is a Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic:
solution: The Preamble declares India to be a Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic.

stem: The body that drafted the Constitution of India was the:
solution: The Constituent Assembly, whose members were chosen by the provincial assemblies, drafted the Constitution.

stem: The rights guaranteed to all citizens, which are protected by the Constitution, are called:
solution: Fundamental Rights are the basic rights guaranteed to citizens (e.g. equality, freedom) and are enforceable by the courts.

stem: The Indian Constitution is notable for being:
options: The shortest constitution in the world
One of the longest written constitutions in the world
solution: The Constitution of India is one of the longest and most detailed written constitutions in the world.
